milestone_name: Approval-Ready Offer Validation and Service Delivery Workflow
purpose: Generate draft-only outreach messages for human review; never auto-send.
allowed_claims: We can prepare an internal AI workflow audit and CEO command brief.
The sprint is designed for read-only observation and evidence-backed decision support.
External actions, publication, and payment are not automated.
claims_requiring_human_review: Any quantified ROI or revenue claim
Any statement that implies endorsement by a third party
forbidden_claims: Access to private systems without explicit permission
personalization_rules: Do not pretend a relationship exists.
tone_rules: Clear that the message is a draft pending approval
evidence_caveat_insertion_rules: Attach evidence basis as internal notes, not external proof claims.
Include caveats where claims are not yet validated by customers.
Keep customer-specific claims out until reviewed.
approval_requirements: Post-action receipt after any approved send
